doc: PaliGemma (PaliGemmaForConditionalGeneration) with a Gemma-1 text decoder, read as its TEXT decoder alone (`text_config`, tensors under `language_model.`; the SigLIP tower and the projector are not lowered here: they are the vision adapters' and the image placement's). transformers computes a prompt of token ids WITHOUT `token_type_ids` causally and with 1-indexed rope positions (a rotation by one more position: the same attention scores); the bidirectional prefix attention an image prompt gets (`use_bidirectional_attention`, ATTN_PREFIX_LM_V1) is not lowered — the spec says so (`prefix_lm`) and a lowering that binds image rows to it is refused by name.

notes: PaliGemma: the text-only causal path; the bidirectional prefix attention over an image prompt (ATTN_PREFIX_LM_V1) is not lowered
